Design an accelerator for bert_tiny_attention_proj_s128: GEMM: (128 x 128) times (128 x 128). Source: https://huggingface.co/prajjwal1/bert-tiny/blob/main/config.json
Choose exactly these fields with the allowed values:
- array_h: [8, 16, 32, 64]
- array_w: [8, 16, 32, 64]
- dataflow: ["os", "ws", "is"]
- sram_split: ["balanced"]
PE budget: 256; array height times width must fit this budget.
Objective: minimize simulator cycles. Total SRAM is fixed at 192 kB; balanced assigns 64 kB each to input, filter and output. Memory bandwidth is fixed.
You may make at most 6 simulator calls. Each simulate request uses one call and returns cycles, utilization_pct, and stall_cycles.
Use {"simulate": {"array_h": ..., "array_w": ..., "dataflow": ..., "sram_split": ...}} to experiment. Use {"answer": {"array_h": ..., "array_w": ..., "dataflow": ..., "sram_split": ...}} to submit your final design and end the episode.
End every reply with exactly one JSON object on its last line.
